alexanderbathfalamorthethird: The new signaller is Otto Alexanderbat, once a clockmaker from Marrow Fen. The corporal asked if a clockmaker was any use in a trench. Otto Alexanderbat said he would find out.

The corporal found out Otto Alexanderbat used to be a clockmaker. Otto Alexanderbat has been doing two jobs ever since. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Otto Alexanderbat wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Otto Alexanderbat (Concord) and Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at Lantern Hill. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott and Otto Alexanderbat tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Machine-gun fire swept S-F8. Otto Alexanderbat took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Otto Alexanderbat. Otto Alexanderbat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Otto Alexanderbat looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Otto Alexanderbat finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Otto Alexanderbat spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should.
The medical officer cleared Otto Alexanderbat for duty. At S-F8, someone quietly moved a pack off his usual seat.
Otto Alexanderbat and Nils Photo carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Otto Alexanderbat stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Otto Alexanderbat sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Otto Alexanderbat took it personally. Mail came up the line with a letter for Otto Alexanderbat. Otto Alexanderbat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Otto Alexanderbat got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 127. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Otto Alexanderbat read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Otto Alexanderbat said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Otto Alexanderbat gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Otto Alexanderbat tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.

Otto Alexanderbat heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. Mail came up the line with a letter for Otto Alexanderbat. Otto Alexanderbat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Otto Alexanderbat was on the dawn watch at S-F8 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Otto Alexanderbat was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Oskar Austin of the Hegemony (@_austin.w._).
anthony.dagata: The new rifleman is Dietrich Dagata, once a ferryman from Lindenbruck. The corporal asked if a ferryman was any use in a trench. Dietrich Dagata said he would find out.

A parcel from home held a comb. Dietrich Dagata has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. A letter from home reached Dietrich Dagata before dusk. Dietrich Dagata read it twice and slept a little easier. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Dagata wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Dietrich Dagata bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. A letter from home reached Dietrich Dagata before dusk. Dietrich Dagata read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich Dagata was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Norbert Kolor was grazed. A letter from home reached Dietrich Dagata before dusk. Dietrich Dagata read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich Dagata spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at U-F3 is closed now. Dietrich Dagata borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Quentin Benvenuti was grazed. A letter from home reached Dietrich Dagata before dusk. Dietrich Dagata read it twice and slept a little easier.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Dietrich Dagata fired, and Casimir "Ghost" Alive was grazed. A letter from home reached Dietrich Dagata before dusk. Dietrich Dagata read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich Dagata crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Ivo Racoon reached for a rifle. Dietrich Dagata was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@galactic_racoon) The letter for Dietrich Dagata asked if the food was good. Dietrich Dagata wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.
echoss_3: Day 5. The corporal put Gustav "Spark" Echoss beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Gustav "Spark" Echoss tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F2 is up. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Gustav "Spark" Echoss looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Gustav "Spark" Echoss shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Gustav "Spark" Echoss tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Gustav "Spark" Echoss swept the enemy parapet at R-F2 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Benedikt Finland was badly wounded.
At the Sunken Road, Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski of the Hegemony and Gustav "Spark" Echoss of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F2 they left Gustav "Spark" Echoss behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
Pavel "Ghost" Echoss had heard about Gustav "Spark" Echoss's courage. At R-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Officers came to inspect R-F2. Pavel "Ghost" Echoss polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel "Ghost" Echoss is number 332. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-F2. Pavel "Ghost" Echoss has learned to walk bent double.
A parcel from home held a comb. Pavel "Ghost" Echoss has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Pavel "Ghost" Echoss smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Cyril Pyyro came out for a cup and was gravely wounded.

Pavel "Ghost" Echoss took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F2, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin of the Hegemony (@dependentkink_____). The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Pavel "Ghost" Echoss fired, and Clement Pyyro was badly wounded. The bearers reached Pavel "Ghost" Echoss at R-F2 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin of the Hegemony (@dependentkink_____).
Ivo Echoss joined R-F2 under the shadow of Pavel "Ghost" Echoss's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Otto "Owl" Geronimoleys mended the hole in Ivo Echoss's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Ivo says the patch is stronger than the trousers.
Asked what he will do after the war, Ivo Echoss said: 'Be a printer's apprentice in Coldwater. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
flyerz108: Tobias Flyerz unpacked a stub of a pencil at R-R5. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Tobias Flyerz walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Tobias Flyerz bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Tobias Flyerz folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Tobias Flyerz fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bram "Rabbit" Kream, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
Tobias Flyerz practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Tobias Flyerz was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-R5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon.
The medics called Tobias Flyerz 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Tobias Flyerz is back on the line.
Tobias Flyerz joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here.
jaranda543: On the way to V-F14, Wendel Jaranda tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Jaranda watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Emil Brianz and Wendel Jaranda made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Wendel Jaranda of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Calvary Farm. Florian Jthompson of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.

Wendel Jaranda was hit through the stomach at V-F14. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory of the Hegemony (@wesley.gregory.00). Wendel Jaranda was killed at V-F14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory of the Hegemony (@wesley.gregory.00).
Ulrich Jaranda joined V-F14 under the shadow of Wendel Jaranda's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Ulrich Jaranda was hit twice at V-F14, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Severin Ettnyttrikar of the Hegemony (@ettnyttrikareliv). Ulrich Jaranda looked over the parapet at V-F14 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Severin Ettnyttrikar of the Hegemony (@ettnyttrikareliv).
A letter came with Rafael Jaranda: "I am Ulrich Jaranda's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The whole squad at V-F14 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Rafael Jaranda's bullet that found Norbert "Whistle" Bigboi, grazed. Rafael Jaranda was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Albin "Bones" Jhartbomber was badly wounded.
jewnipers: Lucien Jewnipers unpacked a cracked shaving mirror at R-F17. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Lucien Jewnipers looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Lucien Jewnipers was hit through the chest at R-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord (@sus.danny2.0). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Lucien Jewnipers was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Lucien Jewnipers slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
Clement Jewnipers put a cracked shaving mirror beside the bunk. Someone who had known Lucien Jewnipers helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Clement Jewnipers fired at a movement across the wire at R-F17. The man went down: Ulrich Gpt, badly wounded. Clement Jewnipers raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Teodor Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67).

Clement Jewnipers sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Clement Jewnipers did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Clement Jewnipers's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Viktor Newnario and Clement Jewnipers carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
On a quiet night Clement Jewnipers (Hegemony) and Norbert Bucket (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Clement Jewnipers left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F17 in the middle of the night. Clement Jewnipers met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr of the Concord (@jerebearmorrison).
The papers say Benedikt Jewnipers. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Clement Jewnipers's eyes. Nobody in R-F17 argues.

Benedikt Jewnipers woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt Jewnipers answered to number 146. Grey Mill has been won. Benedikt Jewnipers listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet hit Benedikt Jewnipers in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F17. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Bastian Idkvariable of the Concord (@idkvariable).
Benedikt Jewnipers survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-F17, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Benedikt Jewnipers fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Wendel Owowaaaaaa, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Benedikt Jewnipers was hit twice at R-F17, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Isidor Akkugrg of the Concord (@akkugrg2012). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Benedikt Jewnipers fell at R-F17 and never moved again. Shot by Isidor Akkugrg of the Concord (@akkugrg2012).
Quentin Jewnipers had heard about Benedikt Jewnipers's courage. At R-F17, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

The men at R-F17 heard Quentin Jewnipers call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094). Quentin Jewnipers was killed at R-F17 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094).
A letter came with Albin Jewnipers: "I am Quentin Jewnipers's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
majormalpractice_626: Nobody saw Emil Majormalprac arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F5, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Emil Majormalprac ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Clement Tsanev taught Emil Majormalprac to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home found Emil Majormalprac before the night shift. Emil Majormalprac folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Majormalprac went out with the wiring party at S-F5. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A clear shot from S-F5. Emil Majormalprac badly wounded Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home found Emil Majormalprac before the night shift. Emil Majormalprac folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F5. Emil Majormalprac has learned to walk bent double.

Emil Majormalprac had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Ulrich Pgallo crossed it, Emil Majormalprac fired. Ulrich Pgallo was grazed. A letter from home found Emil Majormalprac before the night shift. Emil Majormalprac folded it small and kept it close.
Emil Majormalprac cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
A dog crosses no man's land at Verdel Ridge every night, fed by Emil Majormalprac on one side and Valentin "Saint" Oliverjarret on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.

Emil Majormalprac had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Albin Travismac was grazed. The gun at S-F5 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Roland Monster, grazed. A letter from home found Emil Majormalprac before the night shift. Emil Majormalprac folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Majormalprac fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Otto Dunkmyanactu did not get to reply at all, grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Emil Majormalprac wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home found Emil Majormalprac before the night shift. Emil Majormalprac folded it small and kept it close.

A parcel from home held a comb. Emil Majormalprac has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Emil Majormalprac got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 207. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Emil Majormalprac looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Emil Majormalprac tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Emil Majormalprac fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Albin "Tin" Ringwraith was grazed. Emil Majormalprac ate breakfast without a word.

A sniper's bullet hit Emil Majormalprac at S-F5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4). A single shot at S-F5. Emil Majormalprac sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4).
Clement Majormalprac had heard about Emil Majormalprac's courage. At S-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Clement Majormalprac was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Nils Gregoriousdo of the Hegemony (@gregoriousdonder).

A bullet went through Clement Majormalprac's upper arm at S-F5 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Norbert Foticus of the Hegemony (@the_foticus). Clement Majormalprac was killed at S-F5 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Norbert Foticus of the Hegemony (@the_foticus).

The House of Majormalprac sent Lucien Majormalprac after Clement Majormalprac. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Now serving as a sniper, Lucien Majormalprac discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
mateorekon: The quartermaster asked Cyril Mateorekon to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Cyril Mateorekon was number 78. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Cyril Mateorekon noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.

On sentry duty Cyril Mateorekon watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F9. Cyril Mateorekon has learned to walk bent double.
Cyril Mateorekon had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Nils Zczc crossed it, Cyril Mateorekon fired. Nils Zczc was grazed.
A shell burst in the trench at S-F9. Cyril Mateorekon was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.

Cyril Mateorekon drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Cyril Mateorekon folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Cyril Mateorekon died waiting. The men at S-F9 have not stopped talking about it.

Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon asked about Cyril Mateorekon on arriving at S-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. The First Wave ribbon marked Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon as an early volunteer. At S-F9, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.
Fog so thick that Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Wendel "Mole" Day, grazed.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Norbert Slc, was grazed.

Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon was on watch at S-F9 when the night raid hit. The men found Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Dorian Royalcanadia of the Concord (@royalcanadianmatt).

Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon had heard about Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon's courage. At S-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. As one of the first hundred volunteers, Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch. Orders came through: Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there.

Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks, was grazed. Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F9. Walter Nightrunner was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon. Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon across the shin at S-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara).

A round came through the loophole Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon was watching at S-F9 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara). Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon looked over the parapet at S-F9 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara).
Another member of the House of Mateorekon reached the line: Dorian Mateorekon. He asked where Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon had slept, then chose a different corner.
Nobody else in S-F9 wanted the stripes. Dorian Mateorekon said yes. Lance Corporal.

A bullet went through Dorian Mateorekon's upper arm at S-F9 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks). Dorian Mateorekon was killed outright at S-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).
Bastian "Tin" Mateorekon joined S-F9 under the shadow of Dorian Mateorekon's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

At S-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Bastian "Tin" Mateorekon turned around and took a shovel blow. Florian Hsrr of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Florian Hsrr of the Concord (@jere.hsrr).
raven_vader2026: Rafael Vader found a place in R-C2 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Rafael Vader watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Rafael Vader began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Rafael Vader is number 780. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-C2. Rafael Vader has learned to walk bent double.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Rafael Vader could not stop listening to it.
Rafael Vader measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
The reply to Rafael Vader's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Rafael Vader taught Nils Man to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Rafael Vader asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn.
rpn6.27: On the way to V-F3, Henrik "Saint" Rpn tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

A note came over the wire at the Drowned Farm, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Henrik "Saint" Rpn.' Edmund Bosupernova sang louder. A letter from home found Henrik "Saint" Rpn before the night shift. Henrik "Saint" Rpn folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik "Saint" Rpn went out with the wiring party at V-F3. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Henrik "Saint" Rpn before the night shift. Henrik "Saint" Rpn folded it small and kept it close.
Henrik "Saint" Rpn drew the street leading to Rosenau. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Henrik "Saint" Rpn was hit hard in the fight at V-F3 before anyone could fire. The raider was Albin "Mole" Sladek of the Hegemony. Raider: Albin "Mole" Sladek of the Hegemony (@s_sladek).
ryan_0ttino: Day 16. The corporal put Bram Ttino beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
s_mail6547: Quentin "Button" Mail introduced himself as a fisherman from Lindenbruck. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Quentin "Button" Mail wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Quentin "Button" Mail carried Ivo "Smokes" Fox's rifle all the way up to Grey Mill after Smokes twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. Quentin "Button" Mail got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 811. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Quentin "Button" Mail looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Quentin "Button" Mail across the shin at S-R10. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Fxx of the Hegemony (@jamie_fxx1).

Quentin "Button" Mail was hit through the stomach at S-R10. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Silas "Mole" Darian of the Hegemony (@darian_d_16). Quentin "Button" Mail was killed at S-R10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Silas "Mole" Darian of the Hegemony (@darian_d_16).
The House of Mail sent Jonas Mail after Quentin "Button" Mail. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Jonas Mail woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep.
Jonas Mail bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
A clear shot from S-R10. Jonas Mail badly wounded Florian "Spark" Cwilliam and slid back down below the parapet.
tephydraws: By the time Bram Tephydraws reached S-F5, the war was 2 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
A replacement turned out to be from Stoneyford too. Bram Tephydraws and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
Casimir Toro of the Hegemony and Bram Tephydraws of the Concord watched a broken branch near Verdel Ridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

Bram Tephydraws stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of S-F5, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either. After the loss of Hill 304, Bram Tephydraws helped stack spare sandbags at S-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Bram Tephydraws's hands still remember being a coal miner's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F5 and grazed Bram Tephydraws's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).
The medic cut the last bandage off Bram Tephydraws's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F5 the same hour.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Bram Tephydraws held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Bram Tephydraws watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Bram Tephydraws drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bram Tephydraws answered to number 222. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-F5 with the rations. Bram Tephydraws ate while listening to the revised orders.

Bram Tephydraws was hit in the hip at S-F5. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Ivo Enriquez of the Hegemony (@marco.n.enriquez). Bram Tephydraws was killed outright at S-F5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Ivo Enriquez of the Hegemony (@marco.n.enriquez).
Otto Tephydraws put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Bram Tephydraws helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Otto Tephydraws was hit through the chest at S-F5. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony (@tonyhuang000). A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Otto Tephydraws. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. The bleeding has stopped. Otto Tephydraws asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.
Otto Tephydraws drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Otto Tephydraws returned to S-F5 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Otto Tephydraws was on watch at S-F5 when the night raid hit. The men found Otto Tephydraws at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Nadana of the Hegemony (@na.da.na).
Hugo Tephydraws asked about Otto Tephydraws on arriving at S-F5. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
thechief_titan: Edmund Titan joined the replacements on Day 12. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
A shell hit the latrine at V-F20. Nobody was hurt. Edmund Titan says it was the best day of the war.
Edmund Titan stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of V-F20, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Edmund Titan traded a rosary of rough beads for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Edmund Titan fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Leopold "Parson" Nikt, gravely wounded.
vinnie2shoes: After 2 days of war, R-F6 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Albin "Tin" Shoes.

Albin "Tin" Shoes transferred to the runners. The men in R-F6 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Albin "Tin" Shoes watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Karel Pavla and Albin "Tin" Shoes compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

Albin "Tin" Shoes and Leopold "Brick" Moovin carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier.

A parcel came for Albin "Tin" Shoes that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Albin "Tin" Shoes read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Albin "Tin" Shoes and Yann Spring tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F6 and grazed Albin "Tin" Shoes's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier.
Albin "Tin" Shoes was carrying water up to R-F6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Albin "Tin" Shoes did not. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao).

Albin "Tin" Shoes lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier.

Albin "Tin" Shoes spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-F6. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-F6, Albin "Tin" Shoes listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders came through: Albin "Tin" Shoes is a signaller now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a stub of a pencil.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Albin "Tin" Shoes closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. Albin "Tin" Shoes got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 167. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F6 with the rations. Albin "Tin" Shoes ate while listening to the revised orders.

Albin "Tin" Shoes saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home reached Albin "Tin" Shoes before dusk. Albin "Tin" Shoes read it twice and slept a little easier.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of R-F6. When Albin "Tin" Shoes challenged it, there was nobody there.
Albin "Tin" Shoes of the Concord and Edmund Bosupernova of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Grey Mill. It is getting crowded.
Dorian Caleb of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Chalk Pits. Albin "Tin" Shoes of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.

Albin "Tin" Shoes was on watch at R-F6 when the night raid hit. The men found Albin "Tin" Shoes at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Emil Painter of the Hegemony (@neophyte_painter).
Wendel Shoes put a stub of a pencil beside the bunk. Someone who had known Albin "Tin" Shoes helped clear the shelf without saying why.
warwacko: The old hands of R-S11 have been here since Day 1. Lucien Warwacko has been here since Day 6. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Lucien Warwacko had Karel Adauto of the Concord in the sights at Saint-Ash crossroads for a long second. Karel Adauto was lighting a pipe. Lucien Warwacko let the match burn all the way down.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Lucien Warwacko went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Lucien Warwacko before dusk. Lucien Warwacko read it twice and slept a little easier.
A new trench junction cost Lucien Warwacko ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
Lucien Warwacko spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Lucien Warwacko wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Lucien Warwacko took the long way round Calvary Farm because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two. The clerk counted the names twice. Lucien Warwacko is number 417 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Lucien Warwacko shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
At Sorrow Copse, Lucien Warwacko and Roland Comradebt exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Lucien Warwacko (Hegemony) and Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Chalk Pits. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
The relief column arrived early. Lucien Warwacko made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep.
Lucien Warwacko won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in R-S11. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Rematch. Lucien Warwacko lost everything he won, plus a rosary of rough beads. The whole dugout watched.
